dashboard.title: Your overview
dashboard.description: Upcoming visits, what still needs your attention, and quick links.

upcoming.title: Upcoming bookings
upcoming.emptyBody: When you book a verified provider, the visit appears here.

profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.body: Providers need these details before you can book. Health details stay marked as entered by you until a doctor confirms them.
profile.unknown: We could not check your profile right now. You can still open it.

actions.title: Quick actions
actions.findDoctorHint: Verified doctors who visit your area
actions.emergencyHint: Call 112. SureCure Visit does not dispatch emergency help.

state.denied: You do not have access to these bookings.
state.unavailable: Bookings are not available right now.

records.title: Health records
records.description: Signed records from your visits. Drafts are never shown here.
records.emptyBody: After a doctor signs the record of your visit, it appears here.
records.denied: You do not have access to these records.
records.notFound: Not found. This record may not exist or may not be signed yet.
records.readOnly: This is the signed record. It cannot be changed here; your doctor adds any correction as a dated amendment.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Updates about your bookings and records. Notifications never include health details.
notifications.unreadCount: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}
notifications.emptyBody: Booking updates and record alerts appear here.
notifications.notConnectedBody: Check each booking for its latest status. This list starts once the notification service is connected.

booking_declined.title: Booking declined
booking_declined.body: Your provider could not take {reference}. You can choose another provider.

visit_reminder.title: Visit reminder
visit_reminder.body: Your visit for {reference} is coming up. Keep your phone nearby for the arrival code.

record_ready.title: Record ready
record_ready.body: The signed record for {reference} is ready to view.

payment_due.title: Payment due
payment_due.body: Payment for {reference} is due. Online payment is not available yet; pay your provider as agreed.
